functional.statement: A reviewer receives a drafted summary of a case file with every claim linked to its source passage
A reviewer approves, edits or rejects a draft; nothing is published without that decision
A draft the worker is not confident about is escalated to a named human queue

nfr.statement: A draft is produced while the reviewer waits
The control plane stays available when the model provider does not
nfr.target: 99.9% monthly; degraded mode returns the queue position, never a fabricated draft

nfr.statement: Regulated data never leaves the boundary recorded in the compliance profile
nfr.target: 0 unredacted regulated fields in any third-party request, asserted by a test

nfr.statement: A single task cannot consume an unbounded budget
nfr.target: <= 40k tokens and <= 8 tool calls per task, enforced in code

telemetry.note: emit draft.requested / draft.produced / draft.escalated with tenant, latency, token count and grader scores

authz.note: every read and write is scoped by tenant from the authenticated context; the worker plane holds no publish credential

audit.note: every approval, edit, rejection and escalation is written to an append-only audit sink with actor, time and diff

rollback.note: prompt, model pin and worker image are versioned together and roll back as one artifact

monitoring.note: groundedness score, escalation rate, refusal rate and queue depth alert to the on-call rota

canary.note: a prompt or model change reaches 5% of tenants for 24h with automatic abort on groundedness regression

quota.note: per-tenant token and task budgets, enforced in the control plane before the queue

i18n.trigger: when the first non-English regulated market is contracted

multiTenancy.note: row-level tenant scoping; retrieval indexes are per tenant so no prompt can cross the boundary

capacitySlo.note: sized for 4x peak review volume; the queue sheds to human review rather than dropping tasks

dr.note: control-plane database RPO 5 minutes / RTO 1 hour; the worker plane is stateless and rebuilt from the image

compliance.note: named regime recorded in docs/compliance-profile.json with an implemented data-boundary control and a non-expired approval
